payload.justification: The door is closed and the availability of 'open' is unknown. Inspecting the door first will show whether it is locked or can be opened.
payload.expected_outcome: A description of the door's state, including any lock or condition that affects opening or going through it.
payload.subgoal: Determine whether the door can be opened.
plan: Inspect the door to learn its state.
If locked, inspect the box for a usable item.
Go through the door once it is open and unlocked.
